## Checklist

- [ ] One focused change, on a branch off `main` (`fix/…`, `feat/…`, `docs/…`)
- [ ] `xcodebuild test -project CatNotch.xcodeproj -scheme CatNotch -destination 'platform=macOS'` passes
- [ ] New logic in `CatNotchCore` has a test in `CatNotchCoreTests`
- [ ] Any new Swift file is added to `CatNotch.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj`
- [ ] A new feature has a numbered spec in `docs/specs/`
- [ ] My tests and manual runs did not touch the real `~/.claude`
- [ ] UI change: screenshots or a recording are attached
